source_text.body:
Mass-apply to jobs with customized cover letters
A job seeker used Grok to tailor hand-written cover letters to roles matching at least 50% of requirements and send general outreach otherwise, reporting 800+ applications and 6 interviews.
·
Nov 21, 2026
Done with
GB
Grok Bot
What they did
The job seeker hand-wrote cover letters for a few roles that were a close match. They then had Grok adapt those letters for any role where they met at least 50% of the listed requirements. For roles below that threshold, the bot sent a general-purpose outreach message instead.
How it went
Over 800 applications produced 6 interviews. The author says this was the only approach that got traction, though they expect AI screeners to filter such letters and a recruiter screen still follows.
Worth knowing
The author wrote hundreds of applications by hand before switching to AI and wishes they had started sooner.
Try it yourself
with
Grok Bot
Copy prompt
I'm looking for [job title] roles in [location or remote]. Find openings on [job boards], and for each one compare the requirements to my resume at [link or pasted text]. If I match at least 50% of the requirements, tailor my cover letter from [my sample letter] to that role; otherwise draft a short general outreach note to the hiring contact. Put every opening, match score, and draft in a spreadsheet, and pause to show me the first five drafts before sending or submitting anything.
Original source: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50587443
